items.caption: This Western Zhou bronze-script form is analyzed as combining 田 and 土, interpreted as land suitable for habitation.
items.alt: A black graph with a broad, rounded upper enclosure crossed by horizontal strokes and a narrow stem that widens into a base, on a white background.
items.selection_reason: The candidate is identified as 里 and illustrates the reported 田-and-土 analysis of the graph.

limitations.text: The image is a modern vector redraw based on a bronze-script glyph record, not a photograph of an artifact. The identification and interpretation of the graph’s components are reported by the cited dictionary; the original inscription was not independently examined here.
